page.notes: Left margin note spans the lines from "noceat," to "comparasset"; transcribed as one note, with the hyphen "Va-lesij" kept from the printed line break. Διαλέξεις" and "Διάλεξις ὁμιλία" is small and uncertain; the marked letters are doubtful. Italic extent is approximate.
